method: Native scope phases (cycle reversal, layering, crossing order) vs read-only real elkjs 0.11.1 processor snapshots; flat corpus rows failing at HEAD (46 non-oracle-error cases).

earliestDivergence.note: postOrder = cycle reversal, layering and final crossing order all match ELK; remaining differences arise later (placement/routing).

initialCrossingOrder.metric: pre-sweep layer order identical to ELK first crossing count, flat 100 cases (label dummies excluded as naming artifacts: 20 cases)

minimizedCase.finding: Same port ranks and same Random draws; native visited layer 7 as [n7,e8,e11,e12,e20], ELK as [n7,e11,e12,e8,e20] (LongEdgeSplitter append order). Each +-0.035 barycenter perturbation therefore landed on a different node. Rank ties (layer 2: n2 and dummy e19 both rank 4) then broke differently, diverging the first backward sweep at layer 2.

cause: Native seeded crossing minimization with authored node order plus dummies in edge-creation order. ELK seeds with network-simplex component DFS order, then LongEdgeSplitter appends dummies while visiting each layer, its nodes, their authored ports and each port outgoing edges (reversed edges after retained ones). The facade pre-sorted FIXED_SIDE ports, hiding authored port order.
